risk_if_not_implemented: Without Quantum Security Policy, sensitive data with long confidentiality lifetimes remains protected only by quantum-vulnerable cryptography, exposing it to future decryption. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unperformed / Unowned Control Responsibilities (R-GV-3), and most likely increases susceptibility to Dysfunctional Management Practices (MT-8), Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Security, Compliance & Resilience Program (SCRP)
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the design, implementation, and monitoring of security, compliance and resilience governance controls.
compensating_control_1.justification: Publishing Security, Compliance & Resilience Documentation (GOV-02) provides resilience and recovery capability that compensates for the absence of Quantum Security Policy (QTS-01) by ensuring the organization can restore operations when the primary control is absent. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Use of Cryptographic Controls
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of cryptographic protections controls using known public standards and trusted cryptographic technologies.
compensating_control_2.justification: Use of Cryptographic Controls (CRY-02) provides cryptographic protection and key governance that compensates for the absence of Quantum Security Policy (QTS-01) by ensuring data confidentiality and integrity through alternative or complementary cryptographic mechanisms. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
